title: #marypoppins
transcript: so I wanted to share something really special with y'all — like a lot of people our Christmas got derailed this year we had to do it last weekend and my 11 year old nephew who is the son of my late sister um for the first time got me a gift that he picked out himself when he was younger I introduced him to mary poppins and then we watch mary poppins returns there's a whole thing around their dead mother so a lot of a lot emotional connection there and so he got me this hmm it's the mary poppins umbrella and I'm not superstitious I'm gonna open it up but look it says practically perfect in every way and then later on that day we were flipping through family albums and I found a picture of myself at his current age and I said hey look this is me at your age and he said wow you look like me and I said yeah I kind of do and he said but uncle bob when I grow up I don't wanna look like you life is full of ups and downs
